items.title: How Akai and Moog are embracing vibe-coded mods
items.excerpt: inMusic (Akai, Moog, Native Instruments) will open-source devices like the MPC Sample Key and ship an SDK so musicians can vibe-code firmware mods, with a 22-product hacking 'Creator Lab' planned for NAMM; Elektron, by contrast, bans links to vibe-coded firmware hacks.

items.title: As a Nex Playground family we tested the HUUCH Motion Bundle — here's what was fun, what was different and what frustrated us
items.excerpt: The HUUCH Motion Bundle is a compact TV console for kids 3+ that uses AI-powered motion tracking so up to four players control games with their bodies instead of controllers; Tom's Guide compares it with the Nex Playground ahead of the holidays.

items.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
items.excerpt: Underdog released Woof, a 31M-parameter (32MB) open speech-and-music generation model that runs offline on most devices, demoed in a browser game; it follows the 167MB on-device Bark speech-to-text model and a 27B laptop-class model aimed at private, local AI.

items.title: HomeView with an arm? Apple reportedly plans $1,000 swiveling smart panel
items.excerpt: Per The Information, Apple is building a ~$1,000 'HomeView Ultra' (J595) with a 9-inch display on a robotic arm that tracks users and runs proactive smart-home automations; hardware has been done for years but integrating advanced AI features has delayed it to a 2027 announcement.

items.title: 캠시스 “삼성 AI 냉장고용 카메라 양산”
items.excerpt: 캠시스가 삼성전자 냉장고 '비스포크 AI 패밀리허브' 전 모델에 들어가는 카메라 모듈 공급을 시작해 가전용 첫 양산 매출을 냈다. 스마트폰 카메라 모듈 업체가 AI 가전으로 공급처를 넓히는 사례다.
